Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.
Looking ahead, we will significantly increase our gold production in the next three years. This expansion means that K92 is a place for building a stable career, contributing to the community, and being a key part of our success.
About the role
The Biodiversity Advisor is responsible for supporting K92 Mining Limited’s biodiversity conservation, land rehabilitation, and reclamation programs. The role ensures biodiversity values are identified, protected, monitored, and enhanced in line with PNG regulatory requirements, K92 environmental management plans, and international best practice.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Implement and support biodiversity conservation programs in accordance with K92’s Environmental Management Plans (EMP), Biodiversity Management Plan, and regulatory approvals.
Identify, assess, and monitor flora, fauna, and sensitive habitats within the mine footprint and surrounding areas.
Support biodiversity baseline studies, monitoring programs, and impact assessments.
Assist in managing threatened, endemic, and culturally significant species.
Maintain biodiversity monitoring records, databases, and reporting outputs.
Lead and supervise Environment Field Assistants in land rehabilitation, revegetation, and mine closure-related activities.
Support the planning and implementation of progressive rehabilitation and reclamation programs.
Monitor rehabilitation performance, including vegetation survival, growth rates, and ecosystem recovery indicators.
Assist with erosion control, soil management, and invasive species management.
Deliver biodiversity and conservation awareness programs to local communities, landowners, and stakeholders.
Promote sustainable land use practices and community participation in conservation initiatives.
Support community-based rehabilitation, reforestation, and conservation projects where applicable.
Support compliance with PNG environmental legislation, permit conditions, and lender/industry standards.
Contribute to internal and external environmental reporting, including biodiversity and rehabilitation performance.
Assist with environmental audits, inspections, and regulatory engagements.
Promote a strong safety, environmental stewardship, and teamwork culture.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must be qualified at diploma level or above in one of these fields: Environmental Science, Biology, Ecology, Forestry, or Natural Resource Management, with extensive experience in biodiversity conservation, land rehabilitation, and environmental fieldwork, preferably in mining or infrastructure projects. In addition to this, you will have most or all the following:
Knowledge of PNG ecosystems, biodiversity, and community engagement practices.
Experience supervising field teams and community-based programs.
Ability to work in remote site conditions.
Experience in mine rehabilitation and closure planning.
Knowledge of international biodiversity standards (e.g. IFC Performance Standard 6).
Experience working with local communities and landowners in PNG.
Strong report writing and data management skills.
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.

25814.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.
We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans.
At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.
Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas supplier, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project.
For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households.
What you’ll do:
The SGSC Senior Engineer plays a key role in establishing and strengthening the PNG national-led support centre in Port Moresby.
The role supports the safe, reliable and efficient production of oil and gas by delivering high-quality engineering services across Santos’ portfolio of assets. This includes providing technical stewardship, leading engineering deliverables, and ensuring strong risk management and governance within established systems and processes.
As part of the SGSC engineering support workstream, the Senior Engineer works closely with Santos’ operating assets and support teams, taking a leadership role in the delivery of defined engineering services to a consistently high standard. The role has a strong focus on building PNG technical capability through coaching, mentoring and knowledge transfer, contributing to the long-term sustainability and technical depth of the SGSC engineering team.
SGSC Senior Engineers are expected to demonstrate Santos’ values and apply the LEAP behavioural framework in all aspects of their work.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide senior technical support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams across Santos’ assets, including peer review and advice within delegated authority.
Lead the delivery of engineering scopes from problem definition to implementation and close-out, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder alignment.
Act as a technical focal point for stakeholders, managing interfaces to deliver timely, accurate, and fit-for-purpose outcomes. Support operational risk management through Management of Change (MOC), hazard and risk assessments, and barrier management.
Provide technical stewardship and build capability in the SGSC team through mentoring, coaching, and on-the-job development.
Drive business improvement initiatives, including standardisation, technical quality and efficiency improvements, and cost and risk reduction opportunities. Contribute to the development of business plans and processes for the SGSC engineering support workstream.
Manage and coordinate daily engineering activities, prioritising work to meet team objectives while maintaining strong discipline compliance.
Represent SGSC in internal and external interactions, upholding Santos’ values and behavioural expectations.
Support and uphold Santos Health, Safety, and Environmental policies, participating in the implementation of relevant action plans.
Ensure compliance with the Santos Management System (SMS), Delegation of Authority (DOA), and corporate governance requirements.
Apply industry best practices, standards, and specifications in all engineering activities.
What you’ll bring:
As a Senior Engineer in the SGSC, you bring a combination of deep technical expertise, leadership, and operational insight. You have a strong understanding of engineering principles across your discipline, with awareness of multi-discipline interactions, and are experienced in applying process safety, risk management, and problem-solving in operational environments.
You are confident working with stakeholders across multicultural teams, translating technical issues into clear, actionable recommendations, and fostering an inclusive environment where all team members are respected, valued, and able to contribute. You are self-motivated, adaptable, and proactive in driving technical excellence and operational outcomes.
You are also proficient in computer applications, including MS Office and relevant technical software, enabling effective analysis, reporting, and delivery of engineering solutions.
Essential
10+ years’ experience and a proven track record in technical engineering within the oil and gas or related resources industry, supporting operational and maintenance activities.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering scopes and provide technical assurance, including review, verification, and approvals within delegated authority.
Deep discipline knowledge - Process, Mechanical, or Instrumentation & Electrical Engineering with broad multi-discipline awareness.
Strong understanding of process safety, risk management and mitigation.
Strong knowledge of relevant technical standards and regulatory frameworks in the oil and gas industry.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a multicultural, remote-support environment.
Ability to lead and communicate effectively – communicate confidently with stakeholders, build effective working relationships and trust across the organisation in a multicultural environment. Ability to translate technical issues into clear options and recommendations for stakeholders at multiple organisational levels
Be self-motivated, adaptable and demonstrate high initiative.
Proficient computer literacy, particularly in MS Office and relevant technical software.
Bachelor of Engineering (Process, Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation/Control) and Chartered Professional Engineer & RPEQ status, or eligibility.
Desired
Operational asset experience, including brownfield modifications and shutdown/turnaround support.
Experience in project engineering and understanding of project management best practices, or the ability to rapidly develop these skills.
Familiarity with Continuous Improvement methodologies and experience using data to inform decision-making.
Commercial awareness and understanding of economic principles that apply to Oil and Gas production.
What you’ll get:
Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.
At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.
Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.
What you’re part of:
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before
COB Friday 20 March 2026.
A requirement of this role is that you will need to have in place the legal work rights for PNG to apply.
Potential Scams
There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place. You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is
https://recruitment.santos.com/
Apply

26485.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role you will assist with underground drilling, maintaining good housing practices, and adhering to workplace health and safety policies. Safety is the top priority.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Provide assisting role in all underground drilling activities.
Assist drillers and always under the guidance and direction of the driller.
Show guidance and give direction to any utility workers
Ensure that all aspects of duties and tasks outlined are undertaken in accordance with K92 mining procedures and practices.
Ensure that adequate duty of care is exercised in all aspects of work activities.
Ensure a high standard of personal presentation, behaviour, and conduct.
Ensure utmost compliance of Occupational Health and Safety Regulations and any site-specific rules which may apply within varying site operation
Plan and facilitate PPE transactions for National and Local staff.
Plan resupply transporting ahead of time.
Work closely with the Underground Driller to assess Operational requirements
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture within the teams.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure Drilling operations are performed to best standard of safety Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure diamond drilling operations are conducted by competent operators in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures and legislation.
About You
It is requirement of the position that the incumbent possess the following.
Grade 6, but preferable of Grade 10 or Technical Courses
Has one (1) or more years work experience
Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.
Able to communicate effectively at all levels.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

About the role
The Blast Engineer / Magazine Keeper is responsible for the safe planning and governance of underground blasting and explosives storage activities at Kainantu Gold Mine.
The role ensures that the mine’s Explosives and Electronic Blasting System assets are maintained, audited and reconciled; and that all work complies with company procedures and statutory requirements.
The position works cross functionally with Underground Operations, Electrical and IT to ensure reliable blast initiation and continuous operational readiness.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Maintain and audit explosives stock levels in the magazine, ensuring safe storage, access control, and compliance with explosives handling regulations.
Working with the mine’s shotfirers and blast crews on a shift-by-shift basis to ensure blast plans for the shift and the explosive used are aligned and reconciled to comply to site policies regarding explosive orders.
Record and reconcile explosive stocks and inventory using Magman Explosives Management System.
Conduct weekly and monthly magazine stocktakes and reconciliations, maintaining accurate records for regulatory compliance.
Conduct required weekly and monthly Magazine 274 inspections to ensure structural integrity, dryness, ventilation, and safety standards are met (including housekeeping).
Place orders when critical explosives stock levels are reached to ensure uninterrupted blasting operations.
Liaise with Orica, the mine’s main explosive supplier as required to facilitate replenishment.
Maintain and audit blasting system components including detonators, blast boxes, cables, and network hardware.
Perform weekly and monthly CEBS stocktakes and reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and readiness. Update CEBS registry to reflect accordingly.
Place orders for CEBS components when critical stock thresholds are attained.
Troubleshoot CEBS network faults and system failures to minimise misfires and improve system reliability.
Coordinate with IT and Electrical teams on CEBS installation, connectivity, power supply integration, and commissioning requirements.
About You
It is requirement of the position that the incumbent possess the following.
Valid PNG driver licence Class 6
2+ years’ underground drill & blast and/or 5+ years blast crew / explosives magazine experience.
Strong inventory control, reconciliation, and record keeping discipline for explosives and initiation systems
Sound understanding of regulatory compliance for explosives storage, transport and use; able to interpret and apply site procedures.
Effective collaboration with Operations, Electrical and IT; clear written and verbal communication.
High attention to detail, risk awareness, and commitment to safety and housekeeping standards.
Behaviour consistent with K92 Mining’s Values.
Recognised degree or diploma in Mining Engineering or equivalent technical discipline.
Authorisation/permit for explosives handling and magazine keeping

26150.description:
Judicial Growth: Strengthen justice via expert advice.
Prosecution Quality: Boost legal integrity and development.
Strategic Impact: Enhance RPNGC and public confidence.
The opportunity
A high-impact policing partnership is looking for a Police Prosecutions Capability Advisor based in Port Moresby to serve as a key pillar of the RPNGC Prosecutions Directorate. You will ensure that prosecution structures, workflows, and legal practices are managed with the highest level of professional excellence. The role provides the essential technical support and mentoring required to reduce case attrition and protect the interests of the justice sector while ensuring efficient organizational flow.
This is an ideal opportunity for a self-motivated, highly ethical professional in criminal law or justice sector advisory. You will interact with key actors in this key arm of Government, supporting police prosecutors, brief managers, and supervisors, ensuring seamless compliance with national laws and providing sound legal advice to the directorate. The role requires excellent analytical skills and deep technical knowledge to navigate a complex legal environment within an organization undergoing significant capacity development.
The role
The Police Prosecutions Capability Advisor plays a central role in safeguarding the Directorate’s legal and regulatory standing through meticulous capacity building. Responsibilities include assessing existing prosecution structures, supporting provincial functions, and providing expert advice on criminal procedure and rules of evidence. The role serves as a key point of contact for the Office of the Public Prosecutor and the judiciary, providing the mentorship needed to ensure successful case outcomes. The overarching goal is to maintain a legally sound prosecutorial environment through proactive coaching and standardized practices.
Main duties include:
Assess and strengthen police prosecution structures, staffing, and workflows within the Directorate.
Provide expert legal advice on criminal law, procedure, and evidentiary standards to support charge selection and trial preparation.
Provide ongoing mentoring and case-based coaching to prosecutors and brief managers to improve file quality.
Assist in developing and updating prosecution policies, SOPs, manuals, and standardized templates.
Strengthen working relationships between police prosecutors, the Office of the Public Prosecutor, and the judiciary.
Facilitate Prosecution Review Committees to identify and solve systemic issues contributing to case backlogs and failed prosecutions
Qualification and Experience:
Formal Education: Bachelor of Laws (LLB) or an equivalent recognized law degree.
Professional Admission: Admission as a legal practitioner in PNG or another common law jurisdiction.
Core Experience: Significant post-admission experience as a criminal prosecutor, defense lawyer, or legal practitioner with substantial criminal law practice.
Technical Expertise: Demonstrated experience in criminal procedure, evidence, written submissions, and courtroom advocacy.
Mentorship Background: Extensive experience advising or mentoring prosecutors or police legal officers is highly desirable.
Regional Context: Proven ability to build capability of local counterparts within developing countries or Pacific justice sector contexts is preferred.

Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Rice, Snacks, and Bakery products throughout the country. Well-known products and brands include Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Flame Oil & Sugar, Flame Rice, Bilas Bread, Skel Rice, Twisties snacks, Arthurs Pies, and the Meadow Lea range.
At GFI, we care about making food better for everyone.
Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.
We currently have an immediate vacancy for a
Water Treatment Plant Technician who will be responsible for operating, monitoring, and maintaining the water treatment systems to ensure a continuous supply of safe, compliant, and high-quality water for production and site utilities. This role supports plant efficiency, compliance with environmental and safety standards, and contributes to overall operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Operate and monitor water treatment equipment including pumps, filters, chemical dosing systems, and control panels.
Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and minor repairs to ensure optimal performance.
Perform water quality testing (pH, turbidity, chlorine levels, hardness, etc.) and record results accurately.
Adjust treatment processes based on test results and operational requirements.
Maintain logs, reports, and documentation in line with company and regulatory standards.
Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce water usage, improve efficiency, and minimize waste.
Collaborate with engineering and production teams to troubleshoot issues and support plant operations.
Assist with procurement and safe handling of treatment chemicals and consumables.
Participate in training, audits, and emergency response drills as required.
Qualifications & Experience
Certificate or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Environmental Engineering (or equivalent technical qualification).
Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in water treatment, utilities, or industrial plant operations.
Knowledge of water treatment processes, chemical handling, and safety protocols.
Ability to interpret technical manuals, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Computer literacy for data entry and reporting.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Competencies
Safety-conscious and compliant with PPE and workplace standards.
Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Interested candidate send your cv & EOI letter in 1 PDF file to
[email protected]
In the subject line address as "Water Treatment Plant Technician

26321.description:
CreditBank PNG is recruiting a suitable candidate for the role of
Network Manager.
As the Network Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading a team of Network engineers to maintain network infrastructure, optimize network performance and ensuring security compliance for Credit Corporation PNG Limited. This role involves planning, troubleshooting, and collaboration with other IT teams to support business operations.
Primary Responsibilities
Network Monitoring and Maintenance
Design, implement, and manage our organization's local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and wireless networks.
Conduct regular network assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and implement appropriate security patches and updates.
Lead in network capacity planning and scalability assessments to support organizational growth and expansion.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues, working closely with end-users and other IT teams to resolve problems in a timely manner.
Monitor network traffic and bandwidth utilization, identifying potential bottlenecks and implementing optimization strategies.
Monitor network performance and proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure optimal network uptime and reliability.
Oversee the Install, configure, and maintain network equipment, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
Collaboration
Collaborate with IT team members on projects and initiatives that require network support.
Provide training and support to staff on network usage, best practices, and security awareness.
Liaise with vendors for procurement, support, and maintenance of network equipment and services.
Maintain relationships with service providers to ensure optimal service delivery.
Disaster Recovery Planning
Create specific recovery strategies for critical network components, including routers, switches, firewalls, and servers.
Develop and implement disaster recovery plans to ensure network continuity in case of outages or failures.
Test and update recovery procedures regularly.
Ensure failover systems and alternate routes are in place and tested.
Documentation and Knowledge Management
Maintain detailed documentation of network configurations and changes.
Contribute to the knowledge base to improve team efficiency and service quality.
Monitor network usage and plan for capacity to ensure scalability.
Change Management
Participate in change management processes to minimise risk during upgrades and deployments.
Assess the impact of network changes on services and infrastructure.
Work with cross-functional teams to improve network services.
Participate in post-incident reviews to identify areas for improvement.
Other Duties

Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience managing and configuring network infrastructure.

Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) for voice and video solutions.

26319.description:
About the Role:
Responsible for designing, coordinating, and implementing comprehensive training programs that enhance employee skills, promote career development, and align with organizational goals. This role supports talent development and organizational growth by assessing training needs, delivering impactful learning solutions, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, implement, and evaluate training programs that address specific skill gaps and support career growth across the organization.
Facilitate onboarding programs to ensure new hires integrate smoothly and understand company policies, procedures, and culture.
Develop e-learning modules, workshops, and hands-on training sessions to provide diverse learning opportunities.
Conduct regular assessments to identify skill gaps and training needs across departments in alignment with company goals and employee development plans.
Gather feedback from managers, employees, and HR to ensure training programs are relevant and effective.
Partner with managers and department heads to implement individual development plans for employees, focusing on skill enhancement and career progression.
Provide coaching and guidance on best practices to support employee performance and professional growth.
Track and report on the effectiveness of training programs by monitoring participation, engagement, and impact on employee performance.
Utilize feedback to refine and improve training materials and delivery methods.
Manage the training budget and ensure cost-effective solutions by negotiating with external training providers and optimizing internal resources.
Prepare regular reports on training expenses and budget utilization.
Ensure training programs comply with all internal policies and regulatory requirements, updating content to reflect changes in policies or procedures.
Maintain accurate training records and documentation in line with company and legal standards.
Keep current with industry trends, learning methodologies, and best practices in talent development.
Innovate and incorporate new learning tools, techniques, and technology to enhance training delivery and engagement.

Diploma in Human Resource management or Business management is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in human resource management or business management advantageous but not necessary
Certificate 4 in Training & Assessment is preferred
Familiar with iChris Payroll and HR System
Know Labour Laws and Employment Act that governs Employment in PNG
Have 3 – 5 working experiences in training, talent development, or a related HR role, with a proven track record of effective training program implementation.
Ability to build relationships and work effectively across departments.
Skilled in assessing training outcomes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Takes initiative in identifying development needs and proposing solutions.
Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
Ability to assess training needs and design programs tailored to different learning styles.
Proficiency in MS Office.
Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.

If you are passionate about pursuing a career in Training & Development and keen to play a key role in shaping financial solutions that drive responsible growth for our clients and our business needs, we’d love to hear from you. 25861.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Reporting to the Coordinator – Paste Reticulation, this role will be required to ensure the installation of underground paste reticulation and infrastructure is carried out in a safe and efficient manner and in accordance with K92 Mining site requirements and procedures. Paste Crew personnel are also tasked with assisting paste filling operations in the function of conducting routine checks and responding to potential issues that may arise while backfilling.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Operate and maintain underground mobile plant including light vehicles, Volvo L120 IT and Normet scissor lift.
Perform prestart and troubleshooting of fleet and tooling to identify and remedy issues that may arise.
Install Paste Reticulation and associated infrastructure, including Quattro diverter valves.
Operate airleg rock drills while working at heights.
Pre-start inspections of paste filling reticulation lines and exclusion zones.
Respond in a timely manner to any paste blockage events according to response plans.
Respond to routine and emergency calls for repair, service and/or support as required to ensure downtime on plant and equipment is minimised.
Support and assist the Coordinator – Paste Reticulation to ensure the rectification of identified clashes in planned paste reticulation areas.
Work closely with the Senior Specialist – Paste Operations to ensure that all installation QA/QC processes and routine condition monitoring are implemented to maximise results and reduce risk of unplanned downtime.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure equipment maintenance is conducted by competent technicians in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.
About You
It is requirement of the position that the incumbent possess the following.
Experience underground or in a similar role
Tickets in LV, IT, scissor lift & handheld rock drill tools
Ability to work in a fast-paced, physically demanding environment
Ability to work autonomously with limited supervision
Demonstrate abilities to work within a team environment to achieve a common objective
Knowledge of paste backfilling systems
General knowledge of underground equipment
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

26390.description:
CRM Coordinator
Location: Port Moresby
PNG Motors is one of Papua New Guinea’s most recognised automotive groups, representing Ford, Mazda, Hyundai, Suzuki, JMC and Joylong. Every day our teams speak with customers across the country — enquiries, test drives, service bookings, and follow-ups. That creates a lot of information, and we’re looking for someone who can help keep it organised and useful.
The Job (Making Sense of All That Data)
You’ll help manage the systems and information that track our customer relationships. This means keeping customer records organised, making sure sales leads are captured properly, and helping the team follow up with customers at the right time.
You’ll work closely with the sales and marketing teams to monitor enquiries, track leads, and keep our customer database accurate and up to date. From test drive requests to service reminders, you’ll help make sure the right information is in the right place so nothing slips through the cracks.
Part of the role is making sure our CRM system actually works for the team. If something isn’t being used properly or could be improved, you’ll help tidy it up and make it easier for everyone to use. Good data helps the whole business run better — and when the data is messy, everyone feels it.
Who You Are
You’re organised, detail-focused, and comfortable working with systems and data. You enjoy keeping things structured and you notice when something isn’t quite right.
You’re confident working with different teams and can communicate clearly with both sales and marketing staff. You understand that small details matter when dealing with customer information.
Experience working with CRM systems, databases, or sales support tools will be a strong advantage.
Why PNG Motors
You’ll be working with well-known automotive brands and supporting teams across PNG Motors. This role sits between sales and marketing, giving you the chance to help improve how we manage and communicate with our customers.
It’s a practical role, a busy one at times, and a good opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing order to information and helping teams work smarter.
Apply Now
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
Send your CV and a short cover note to
[email protected]
. In your cover note, tell us a bit about
why you’d like to work with PNG Motors
and what interests you about the role.
Applications close: 16 March 2026
Apply
